title: Zapper DeFi Position Position Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zapper:defi value_usd=*
| stats sum(value_usd) as total_value, avg(value_usd) as avg_value by protocol
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks protocol values by total and average position value across Zapper DeFi position events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `value_usd` values for each Zapper DeFi position event and review total and average position value by protocol.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total position value.
grandmaExplanation: It honestly which protocol shows the biggest position value numbers in your Zapper DeFi position data.
